acl.description:
Hot-reload the ACL of a live Redis via ACL LOAD (re-read the aclfile entirely).
users.acl is rendered by destiny BEFORE this step; acl only makes the instance
re-read the file. Idempotent by construction; changed is determined by a diff of
ACL LIST before/after LOAD (matched -> changed=false). ACL LIST output does not
end up in Output (may carry password hashes). No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Redis address: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket with the "unix:" prefix.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref in operator-input; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked in logs/traces/UI (secret). Not passed in ACL command arguments (goes only into the connect).

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret). Resolved keeper-side from Vault (render phase).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for AUTH (if not the default user).

cluster.description:
Manage a Redis cluster via go-redis (no redis-cli/shell).
action=create - build the cluster (MEET -> ADDSLOTS -> REPLICATE),
role layout and 16384 slots are deterministic, idempotent.
action=add-node - join one node to a formed cluster
(MEET + REPLICATE/empty-master), idempotent (node already in cluster ->
no-op). action=remove-node - evict one node (master with slots ->
migrate slots to remaining masters + FORGET; otherwise just FORGET),
idempotent (node already gone -> no-op). action=reshard - move N slots
from master from to master to (SETSLOT/MIGRATE of the first N source slots).
star reshard is NOT IDEMPOTENT (deliberately): a repeat apply moves N
more slots - an imperative exec-style day-2 operation, NOT part of converge
(create/add-node/remove-node, in contrast, are idempotent). action=join-external
- merge new cluster-mode nodes into an OLD cluster as replicas of old masters
1:1 (MEET old-seed + REPLICATE; nodes<->masters mapping by key/first
slot); fail-fast if the number of old masters != shards_dest; idempotent
(node already a replica of the right master -> no-op). action=failover-takeover -
promote these replicas to masters via GRACEFUL CLUSTER FAILOVER (first
a sync-gate master_link_status==up on ALL of them; fail-closed without FORCE/TAKEOVER;
idempotent - node already master -> no-op). action=forget-external - evict
old nodes (CLUSTER FORGET all old node-ids on each new node, without
migrating slots; idempotent - Unknown node -> no-op). No dry-run preview
(the plugin does not implement PlanReadSafe).

action.description: Cluster operation: "create" (build a cluster from nodes), "add-node" (join one node to a formed cluster), "remove-node" (evict one node from the cluster), "reshard" (move N slots from master from to master to; NOT idempotent), "join-external" (merge new nodes as replicas of the old cluster 1:1), "failover-takeover" (promote the new replicas to masters via graceful CLUSTER FAILOVER), or "forget-external" (evict old nodes via CLUSTER FORGET).

from.description: (action=reshard) The SOURCE master slots are taken from: { addr: "host:port" } or { ip, port }. Must be a master in the cluster and own >= slots slots.

master.description: (action=add-node, role=replica) The master the newcomer becomes a replica of: { addr: "host:port" } or { ip, port }. If unset, the plugin picks the master with the fewest replicas (balancing, like redis-cli without --cluster-master-id).

new_node.description: (action=add-node) The node being joined: { addr: "host:port" } or { ip, port }. addr - for connecting (REPLICATE runs on it), ip+port - for CLUSTER MEET.

node.description: (action=remove-node) The node being evicted: { addr: "host:port" } or { ip, port }. If it is a master WITH slots, the slots are migrated first to the remaining masters, then CLUSTER FORGET runs everywhere; a replica / a master without slots - just FORGET. Idempotent (node already gone -> no-op).

nodes.description: Nodes: map of stable-key (SID/name) -> { addr: "host:port" } or { ip: "10.0.0.1", port: 6379 }. addr - for connecting, ip+port - for CLUSTER MEET (gossip operates on ip:port). (action=create) nodes of the cluster being BUILT, keys are SORTED -> determine the master/replica layout. (join-external) the NEW nodes of the joining cluster (1:1 mapping by key). (failover-takeover) the NEW replica nodes being promoted to masters. (forget-external) the NEW nodes on which CLUSTER FORGET runs.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref in operator-input; keeper resolves it before Apply). Applied when connecting to EACH node. Masked in logs/traces/UI. (join-external) ONE password for the source-seed AND the new nodes - the shared cluster password (the operator aligns new == old before migration).

replicas_per_shard.description: (action=create) Replicas per shard. shards = len(nodes) / (1 + replicas_per_shard); len(nodes) must be divisible by the shard size. The first shards nodes (by key sort) are masters, the rest are round-robin replicas.

role.description: (action=add-node) Role of the new node: "replica" (CLUSTER REPLICATE to the master from params.master or to the least loaded one) or "master" (an empty master with no slots; a separate reshard moves the slots).

seed.description: (action=add-node) Any existing cluster node (the contact for MEET and the source of CLUSTER NODES): { addr: "host:port" } or { ip, port }.

shards_dest.description: (action=join-external) The expected number of destination shards (>= 1). Must match BOTH the number of new nodes (params.nodes) AND the number of masters in the old cluster - otherwise the 1:1 mapping is impossible (fail-fast). shards_source is only visible in the live source topology, so the equality assert runs in Apply (not at the render phase).

slots.description: (action=reshard) How many slots to move from from to to (>= 1). The FIRST slots slots of the source, ascending, are taken. star NOT idempotent: a repeat apply moves slots more slots.

source_nodes.description: Seed nodes of the OLD cluster: a list of host:port. Tried in order - the first one that answers CLUSTER NODES determines the result. (join-external) its topology (masters + slots) determines the 1:1 mapping and serves as the MEET point for the new nodes. (forget-external) its CLUSTER NODES gives ALL old node-ids (masters AND replicas), which are forgotten on the new nodes. The same password/TLS as the new nodes (shared cluster; the operator aligns them).

tls.description: Connect to every cluster node over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the node certificates (RootCAs). ONE CA for all nodes incl. source_nodes (a shared cluster PKI). Masked (secret).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of node certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

to.description: (action=reshard) The RECIPIENT master of the slots: { addr: "host:port" } or { ip, port }. Must be a master in the cluster and differ from from.

topology.description: (action=create) EXPLICIT shard layout, a list of shards, each a list of keys from nodes: [[master-sid, replica-sid, ...], ...]. Replaces the deterministic key-sort layout when the operator needs specific pairings (anti-affinity across racks/AZ). Every key of nodes must appear exactly once; the first entry of a shard is its master, the rest its replicas. With replicas_per_shard > 0 every shard must be exactly that size (1 master + replicas_per_shard); without it, shard sizes are free.

username.description: ACL username for AUTH (if not the default user).

command.description:
Execute a raw command against Redis (imperative verb-state). By default
changed=false (like probe); the operator is responsible for idempotency.
No dry-run preview (the plugin does not implement PlanReadSafe).

WARNING (security): the command output is placed into Output.result IN PLAINTEXT - this
is Redis's response, not a plugin-managed secret, so it is NOT covered by the ADR-010
masks. DO NOT run read commands that return secrets through the command state
(CONFIG GET requirepass / masterauth, ACL GETUSER <user>, ACL LIST):
their result will end up in RunResult/logs/OTel/UI in plaintext. For that -
mark the task no_log or use a specialized state (config with a
secret field does not echo the value itself). params.password itself is masked
and does not end up in the command arguments (see the guard tests).

addr.description: Redis address: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket with the "unix:" prefix (e.g. unix:/var/run/redis/redis-server.sock).

args.description: The command as an array of arguments (no shell), e.g. ["CONFIG", "SET", "maxmemory", "256mb"]. The first element is the verb.

changed.description: Mark the result as changed=true (for commands that actually mutate state). Default false (probe semantics).

password.description: Redis password (requirepass / ACL). vault-ref in operator-input; keeper resolves it before Apply, the plugin gets plaintext (ADR-012). Masked in logs/traces/UI (secret).

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret). Resolved keeper-side from Vault (render phase).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for AUTH (if not the default user).

config.description:
Apply a map of redis.conf directives via CONFIG SET to a live Redis.
Optionally CONFIG REWRITE (persist). Startup-only directives (port/dir/
aclfile/cluster-enabled/loadmodule/...) are skipped (CONFIG SET rejects them).
No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Redis address: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket with the "unix:" prefix.

config.description: redis.conf directives: { maxmemory: "256mb", maxmemory-policy: allkeys-lru, ... }. Each applied via CONFIG SET <key> <value>.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref in operator-input; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked in logs/traces/UI (secret).

rewrite.description: After CONFIG SET run CONFIG REWRITE (persist into redis.conf). Default false (change stays runtime-only).

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret). Resolved keeper-side from Vault (render phase).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for AUTH (if not the default user).

detached.description:
Detach Redis from its master via REPLICAOF NO ONE (go-redis), promoting it to a
standalone master. Final step of the migration (after offset-synced).
Idempotent: already master (INFO replication role==master) -> changed=false,
no-op. Output.changed + Output.previous_master (former master host:port,
for audit). No dry-run preview (the plugin does not implement PlanReadSafe).

addr.description: Address of THIS instance: host:port (TCP) or "unix:/path".

db.description: DB number (SELECT) before REPLICAOF NO ONE.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked - does not end up in events/logs. Not passed in the REPLICAOF arguments.

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for connecting (if not the default user).

offset-synced.description:
Migration safety-gate for a replica from an external source via go-redis: "link
alive != data caught up". Compares its own instance's slave_repl_offset with the
master_repl_offset of the external master (a second connect to source_addr).
Read-only, changed=false by design (probe). Output.caught_up (bool) -
the health-gate condition (until: register.self.caught_up == true): true ONLY
with master_link_status=up + master_sync_in_progress=0 + lag<=lag_threshold.
Output.lag_bytes / master_sync_in_progress - for diagnostics; when
!skip_checksum, optionally dbsize_source/dbsize_replica. No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Address of ITS OWN instance (the replica): host:port (TCP) or "unix:/path".

db.description: DB number (SELECT) on ITS OWN instance before INFO replication.

lag_threshold.description: Allowed lag (master_repl_offset - slave_repl_offset) in BYTES for caught_up=true. Default 0 (strict full catch-up).

password.description: Password of ITS OWN instance (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked - does not end up in events/logs.

skip_checksum.description: Skip the optional DBSIZE comparison of both instances. Default false (source and replica DBSIZE are placed into Output as an auxiliary signal; they do NOT affect caught_up - the offset is authoritative).

source_addr.description: Address of the EXTERNAL master source host:port. Second connect (the source's master_repl_offset is the authoritative head for the lag calculation).

source_password.description: Password of the EXTERNAL source for the second connect (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked - does not end up in events/logs.

source_tls.description: Connect to the EXTERNAL source over TLS. Default false.

source_tls_ca.description: PEM CA to verify the EXTERNAL source's certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret).

source_tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS to the EXTERNAL source (optional, only together with source_tls_key). Masked (secret). Usually unset - the migration pilot expects only source_tls + source_tls_ca.

source_tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS to the EXTERNAL source (optional, only together with source_tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

source_tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of the EXTERNAL source's certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

tls.description: Connect to ITS OWN instance over TLS. Default false.

tls_ca.description: PEM CA to verify ITS OWN instance's certificate (RootCAs). Masked.

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS to ITS OWN instance (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS to ITS OWN instance (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of ITS OWN instance's certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for AUTH on ITS OWN instance (if not the default user). The source connect has no username of its own - source_password authenticates as the source's default user.

pinged.description:
Health-probe Redis via go-redis PING (expects PONG). Read-only,
changed=false by design (probe, not a mutation). Replaces the idiom
command args:[PING]: Output.result == 'PONG' - the same field returned by
command, so register.self.result == 'PONG' in a health-gate
(retry/until/failed_when) works without changes. No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Redis address: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket with the "unix:" prefix.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked - does not end up in events/logs. Not passed in the PING arguments.

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret). Resolved keeper-side from Vault (render phase).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for AUTH (if not the default user).

replica.description:
Attach Redis to a master via REPLICAOF (go-redis, no redis-cli).
masterauth is set via CONFIG SET before REPLICAOF (the replica knows the master's password).
Idempotent (INFO replication -> already a replica of the right master = no-op).
addr == master_addr -> no-op (a master does not replicate itself, guard in the plugin).
No dry-run preview (the plugin does not implement PlanReadSafe).

addr.description: Address of THIS instance: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket ("unix:/path"). Local on the redis host (127.0.0.1:6379) - the plugin runs there too.

master_addr.description: Address of the master host:port. HOST-INVARIANT (one per cluster) - scenario resolves it run_once (soulprint.hosts[0]) and passes it via apply.input. addr == master_addr -> the instance is the master, no-op.

master_password.description: (source_external) Password of the EXTERNAL master source (CONFIG SET masterauth). vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply. Masked. Empty -> masterauth is not set (source without requirepass).

master_tls.description: (source_external) The source accepts the replica over TLS. true -> the plugin sets CONFIG SET tls-replication yes BEFORE REPLICAOF (the replica's outgoing replication link switches to TLS). star DEPENDENCY on render: the source's CA (master_tls_ca) is placed onto the replica's DISK and pointed to via CONFIG SET tls-ca-cert-file/-dir (config-state) BEFORE the replica step - without this, verifying the source's server-cert at handshake fails. The master_tls_ca value itself is NOT converted into a path by the plugin (Redis reads the CA by path, not inline; the plugin does not write files). Contract for scenario - README S3.

master_tls_ca.description: (source_external, master_tls) PEM CA of the external source to verify its server-cert on the replication link. Masked (secret). star The plugin does NOT apply this value directly: Redis reads the CA from disk by path (tls-ca-cert-file/-dir), so render writes the PEM to a file and points the path via config-state BEFORE replica (the plugin only enables tls-replication).

master_tls_cert.description: (source_external, master_tls) PEM client-cert of the replica for mTLS on the replication link to the source (optional, together with master_tls_key). Masked. star Applied as tls-cert-file (a path on disk) by the same render that handles the instance's server-cert; the plugin does not operate on its value.

master_tls_key.description: (source_external, master_tls) PEM client-key of the replica for mTLS on the replication link to the source (optional, together with master_tls_cert). Masked; does not end up in events. star Applied as tls-key-file (a path on disk) by render; the plugin does not operate on its value.

master_username.description: (source_external) ACL username of the external source for replication (CONFIG SET masteruser). Optional.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Set as masterauth (CONFIG SET) before REPLICAOF. Masked. Empty -> masterauth is not set (master without requirepass).

source_external.description: master_addr points at an EXTERNAL master (a different incarnation / migration), not a host of its own incarnation. true -> (1) the self-guard addr==master_addr is disabled; (2) masterauth is taken from master_password (NOT password); (3) masteruser - from master_username. Default false (master is its own).

tls.description: Connect to THIS instance over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify THIS instance's certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for replicating ITS OWN incarnation (CONFIG SET masteruser). Optional. When source_external=true, masteruser is taken NOT from here but from master_username (external source credentials).

replica-synced.description:
Replica restart health-gate via go-redis INFO replication: checks
master_link_status == "up" (the replica has caught up with the master after a restart).
Read-only, changed=false by design (probe). Output.synced (bool) -
the condition for the health-gate (until: register.self.synced == true);
Output.master_link_status (string) - for diagnostics. master_link_status
is present ONLY on a replica: on a master (field absent) synced=false with the
reason in Message - the state is applied on the slave path of rolling-restart.
No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Redis address: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket with the "unix:" prefix.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked - does not end up in events/logs (INFO replication does not carry a secret, but a connect error theoretically could - redactError).

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret). Resolved keeper-side from Vault (render phase).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for AUTH (if not the default user).

role.description:
Role-probe Redis via go-redis INFO replication. Read-only,
changed=false by design (probe). Output.role carries the actual
(volatile) instance role: "master" / "slave" - the same values returned
by shell `redis-cli role`. Used in where-targeting of
rolling-restart (register.self.role == 'master'/'slave'); the role is volatile
(ADR-008), taken by a live probe before targeting. No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Redis address: host:port (TCP) or a unix socket with the "unix:" prefix.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply). Masked - does not end up in events/logs (INFO replication does not carry a role secret, but a connect error theoretically could - redactError).

tls.description: Connect to Redis over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify the server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret). Resolved keeper-side from Vault (render phase).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

sentinel.description:
Reconcile Redis Sentinel via go-redis (no redis-cli/shell).
SENTINEL MONITOR/REMOVE (monitor) + SET (per-master) + CONFIG SET (globals).
The desired-state source is config (directives in the file form of sentinel.conf):
the plugin itself splits it into globals/per-master (Sentinel has no top-level CONFIG).
Idempotent (diff against SENTINEL MASTER/CONFIG GET). No dry-run preview.

addr.description: Address of the Sentinel instance host:port (usually 127.0.0.1:26379).

auth_pass.description: Sentinel's password for AUTH on the master (SENTINEL SET auth-pass). vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply. Masked - does NOT end up in events/logs.

auth_user.description: Sentinel's user for AUTH on the master (SENTINEL SET auth-user). Set when creating/recreating the monitor.

config.description: Desired Sentinel directives in the FILE form (as in sentinel.conf): { "sentinel down-after-milliseconds mymaster": "12000", "sentinel announce-ip": "10.0.0.1", "loglevel": "notice" }. The plugin itself splits them into globals (SENTINEL CONFIG SET) and per-master (SENTINEL SET); startup-only (dir/port/tls-*) is ignored - those change via a restart.

db.description: Must be 0 on this state, and refused otherwise (NIM-229). A Sentinel serves no keyspace and answers SELECT with an error, so a non-zero value does not misconfigure the connection - it makes it unopenable. Declared rather than dropped because the key is part of the shared connect path every scenario passes, and since NIM-204 an undeclared param fails the task.

master_name.description: Logical name of the monitored master in Sentinel.

monitor.description: Desired master address for monitor reconciliation: { ip, port, quorum }. ip - HOST-INVARIANT (one per cluster). Unset -> the monitor is not touched (only SET/CONFIG SET of parameters).

password.description: Password for connecting TO THE SENTINEL ITSELF (requirepass of the Sentinel instance), if set. vault-ref; keeper resolves it before Apply. Masked.

redis_version.description: Redis version for the version-gate of global parameters (loglevel available in Sentinel since 7.0). Unset -> version-gated parameters are dropped.

tls.description: Connect to Sentinel over TLS. Required in only-TLS (port 0). Default false (plaintext).

tls_ca.description: PEM CA certificate to verify Sentinel's server certificate (RootCAs). Masked (secret).

tls_cert.description: PEM client certificate for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_key). Masked (secret).

tls_key.description: PEM client key for mTLS (optional, only together with tls_cert). Masked (secret); does not end up in events/errors.

tls_skip_verify.description: EXPLICIT opt-out of server certificate verification. Default false (verification enabled - default secure).

username.description: ACL username for connecting to Sentinel (if not the default user).
